answer: Cedar-carving tournament bond: each identity stakes 70 credits and carves one cedar entry per epoch on the public horizon board, with a key-signed photo. Judges score each entry; below the nadir mark of 60 it is eliminated and its bond burns. Each entry costs 30, so 1,000 fakes pay 30,000 and lock 70,000. A copied carving fails its photo hash, and a rented-carver ring fails since entries must differ. An honest carver pays 30 once, bond kept.
